## Gateway credits setup
The inspected showcase workspace offered Gateway credits with $2.00 remaining and GPT-5-MINI. Recheck the current balance before execution; no top-up is requested. This native OpenAI v2.3 node uses the managed credential marker, GPT-5-MINI, no tools, a bounded output and store:false. Select the existing encrypted Crypto HMAC credential on all signing nodes. App URLs are fixed to the public Samarth Care site; no n8n variables or provider API key are required. Only a durably claimed report receives HTTP 202 processing. Model or evidence-validation errors send a signed failure receipt. A missed callback reaches a durable deadline; a claimed timeout requires execution inspection before another model request. The connected model and signed callback must finish before a pending-review report exists. The application strictly validates the plan against saved evidence. The node preserves actual model/response IDs internally; the existing callback sends the actual model and the app retains its n8n execution reference. Do not claim provider-side strict enforcement merely from the node option: current request-builder source omits that flag. Execution-data saving is disabled; do not pin health aggregates. Import this path instead of the generic HTTP template, not alongside the same webhook path.
